messages:
rowan: deploy-bot just warned about na-central canary p95 + error bump. Auto-revert in ~4m. Thoughts?
deploy-bot: ALERT: na-central canary p95 340ms (+160ms) and 1.8% 5xxs over 2m. Auto-revert scheduled in 4m. Use /deploybot ack to suppress.
rowan: If it's transient we let it run; if sustained >3m we should manual-rollback. Anya, can you check logs/traces?
anya: Looking. Traces show a small percentage of requests hitting a new serialization path that times out under load. Appears correlated with large request bodies.
samir: Recommend scoped rollback for na-central only to v1.12.5. Staged 25% -> 100% with short wait. I'll prep a customer blurb for any affected Dedicated tenants.
rowan: Okay suppress and execute. I'll ack suppression. ```/deploybot ack suppress --thread 1749990300 --by rowan --reason "manual investigate + staged rollback" --until 2026-02-15T10:00:00Z```
deploy-bot: CONFIRMED: suppression acked by rowan until 2026-02-15T10:00:00Z (sup-4a1e). Monitoring continues.
anya: Starting staged rollback to v1.12.5: 25% -> 100%. ```/deploybot rollout set-version --region na-central --version v1.12.5 --traffic 25% --staged --step-duration 180s --thread 1749990300```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Started staged rollback to v1.12.5 in na-central. Step 1: 25% -> monitoring.
samir: Sent customer note to PlatformLead and KeyClientOps. They acknowledged.
anya: After step 1 p95 down to 190ms, 5xx 0.3%. Proceeding to 100% now. ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 100% --thread 1749990300```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Rollback to v1.12.5 completed to 100% at 2026-02-15T09:58:35Z. Telemetry: p95 180ms, 5xx 0.1%.
rowan: Great. Pin na-central to v1.12.5 for 6h and open a follow-up to update serialization path and add an autoscale test. ```/deploybot pin-version --region na-central --version v1.12.5 --duration 6h```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Pin applied for 6h.
samir: I'll draft the postmortem outline and include suppression id sup-4a1e.
rowan: Thanks team. Quick retro tomorrow to tweak auto-revert thresholds for large-body requests. :thumbsup:
